map.统计关键词在文本中出现的密度。: Measure the density of keywords in a text.
map.：密度 = 某词出现次数 ÷ 总词数 × 100%。: : density = occurrences of a word ÷ total words × 100%.
map.：需先分词并过滤停用词（如「的」「了」「the」「and」），否则结果无意义。: : tokenization and stop-word filtering (for example English "the"/"and" or Chinese particles) come first, or the result is meaningless.
map.：SEO 检查；但刻意堆砌关键词会被搜索引擎判定为作弊。: : SEO checks; but deliberately stuffing keywords is treated as cheating by search engines.
map.：必须先做分词，简单按字统计会严重失真。: : tokenization is a must; counting by character alone badly distorts the result.

map.自查页面是否被过度优化：统计核心词出现占比，若明显高于同题材正常水平，可能被搜索: Self-check whether a page is over-optimized: measure how much the core term appears; if it is clearly above the normal level for that topic, search engines may treat it as stuffing.
map.不是，堆砌会被判作弊。: No. Stuffing is treated as cheating.
map.没有统一阈值，搜索引擎早已不按固定比例排名。更实际的判断是与同题材优质页面对比：: There is no universal threshold, and search engines stopped ranking by a fixed ratio long ago. A more practical test is to compare with high-quality pages on the same topic: if your density is clearly higher and the text reads stiffly, lower it. When writing, prioritize natural sentences and good coverage of synonyms and related terms rather than repeatedly inserting the target word.
